module_summary: Gshare branch predictor: XOR of PC and global history indexes a 128-entry table of 2-bit saturating counters, with separate predict and train ports and history recovery on mispredict.

anchors.name: pht
anchors.why: 128-entry 2-bit saturating counter table, read for prediction, updated on training

anchors.name: predict_history_r
anchors.why: Global branch history register, shifted on predict, recovered on mispredict

anchors.name: predict_index
anchors.why: History XOR predict_pc hash indexing PHT for prediction

anchors.name: train_index
anchors.why: Train history XOR train_pc hash selecting PHT entry to update

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Prediction request; gates outputs and history shift

anchors.name: predict_pc
anchors.why: Fetch PC hashed with history to form predict index

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Predicted direction from PHT counter MSB

anchors.name: predict_history
anchors.why: History snapshot used for the prediction, output with it

anchors.name: train_valid
anchors.why: Training request; enables PHT counter update

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual outcome; increments or decrements counter and recovers history

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Mispredict flag triggering history register recovery

anchors.name: train_history
anchors.why: Trained branch history, used for index and recovery

anchors.name: train_pc
anchors.why: Trained branch PC hashed into train index

groups.name: Pattern history table
groups.description: 2-bit saturating counters read by predict, updated by train

groups.name: Global history
groups.description: History shift register with mispredict recovery, exported per prediction

groups.name: Index hashing
groups.description: XOR hashes of PC and history for predict and train

groups.name: Predict port
groups.description: Prediction request and taken direction output

groups.name: Train port
groups.description: Training request with outcome, mispredict, history and PC
